notes.title: Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/4a4541d5c11d0f52218fad6e8371aae572b16eb2.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111080/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate/

[h1]Use magic spells and military surplus explosives to topple an evil crime syndicate hidden beneath a prestigious wizarding school. Learn spells, engage in espionage, and spread lore-unfriendly chaos. [/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/8a10814a7cc6b72e23f82b9f42a3b57ac9509b37.gif[/img]

[u]Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate[/u] is a comedic sandbox with a complete lack of safety nets or boundaries.  Players are free to indulge in the full abject chaos of untethered physics simulations and uncontainable emergent gameplay, using a toolkit of magical spells and items to solve problems in ways we cannot hope to balance against.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/41808760a60aae8aeb109cad8ea3bb4fddf828b1.gif[/img]

Wizard Boy can also team up with other Wizard Boys in cooperative(?) multiplayer to explore (blow up) the castle together and thwart the evil International crime syndicate S.P.I.D.E.R once and for all!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/936ff34a9038dfe99745f535206b311537012ad3.gif[/img]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] A multitude of spells to learn and inflict on others
[*] Chaotic, barely contained physics-based mayhem
[*] Open-ended goals to accomplish (or ignore) however you see fit
[*] Online co-op, although actual cooperation is unlikely
[*] Retro-themed third person action, straight from the days of Unreal Engine 1
[*] Landmines and other non-magical ordnance
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111080/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate/

notes.title: The Pony Factory is out now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536530/The_Pony_Factory/
Winston arrived at a solution to the moral decay of his town.

He called out to hell, and hell answered. The human body could, hell promised, be twisted and stretched into a kinder, more equine shape. Winston's town, now filled with ignorant hate-mongers, could instead be filled with magical ponies, if he could provide a factory in which to make them. Winston thought they would be beautiful, gentle, and good.

[i][b]Hell had other plans...[/b][/i]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/f5b229a724a8109c1102ffd3ab63b19ca8c0ae9d.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536530/The_Pony_Factory/]The Pony Factory[/url] is a short action/horror game inspired by Doom 3, with a darkly comedic story, striking black and white visual style, and visceral FPS gameplay. This is an updated standalone release of the original game, which was created in 7 days as part of the Dread X Collection 1.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Meaty FPS combat against highly agile foes who will attempt to evade and flank you.
[*]Darkness is your enemy!  Use muzzle flashes, sparks, sound, and other clues to track foes during combat.
[*]High contrast black and white aesthetic inspired by early 1950's science fiction films.
[*]A short minimalist campaign that can be completed in about 30 minutes.
[*]Numerous improvements from the original release, including many new quality of life features, balance and game feel improvements, new story and gameplay content, full gamepad support, and of course bugfixes!
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/95215f003c102674f4b81e4e08fa0ab9bbb4d4dc.png[/img]

My brother [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/szymanski]John Szymanski[/url] (director of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574260/My_Friendly_Neighborhood/]My Friendly Neighborhood[/url]) assisted with this version and will be receiving half of the royalties in an effort to provide him with enough income to continue game development until he begins receiving money from MFN.

notes.title: Steam officially recognizes boomer shooters, so here are 6 of the best
notes.notes:
Like it or not, 'boomer shooters' are here to stay. Steam now officially recognizes the moniker as the go-to description for the throwback FPS games, with Valve adding the term as a Steam category that developers and users can tag games with. It's a term that signifies a throwback to the heady days of classic, fast-paced shooters such as Doom, Quake, Hexen, and Heretic, typically matched with retro graphics reminiscent of the '90s and early '00s.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Anniversary Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=RD2rc2uuoiY;full][/previewyoutube]
Chop Goblins is (almost) one year old!

Well, technically it will be one year old on December 12th, but that's two days after both Dusk and Doom are having big anniversary milestones so... we're doing a Chop Goblins anniversary celebration today instead!

Here's what the Anniversary Update brings to the game...

[h1]NEW WEAPONS[/h1]

Enjoy two powerful new weapons... the Scattergun and the Six Shooter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/cffbfcf26457af59b2f8ff3a31f6749d0dd7ab66.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/9d055654bd74ba6dff35196b0fa843894d09094f.jpg[/img]

These will replace the Flintlock and Street Sweeper respectively if you turn on "Alt Weapons" on the difficulty selection screen, but you can still use both the Flintlock and Street Sweeper by hitting the corresponding weapon selection key twice.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43173390/b41024b5a7141767c77d2c8e548378a6f8c9f90f.png[/img]

Which means that it is now both easy and effective to quickswap between all six weapons, if you want to try playing Chop Goblins like it's Doom Eternal.  You should, it's fun.

[h1]BETTER DAGGER[/h1]
A bit, at least.  The dagger now attacks slightly faster and does slightly more damage, allowing you to consistently one-shot low level enemies (i.e the annoying brown ones) and better deflect projectiles.

[h1]CHOKE UPGRADE NOW IN MAIN LEVELS[/h1]
The Street Sweeper's choke upgrade, previously found only in the bonus levels, can now be acquired in the original campaign as well.  I don't actually remember where I put it though.  Someone let me know.

[h1]THE GAME RUNS BETTER[/h1]
Most of you will probably have to take my word for it, but Chop Goblins should run better on lower end machines now, thanks to a collection of different optimizations and tweaks under the hood.

[h1]CELEBRATE ONE YEAR OF MURDERING CHOP GOBLINS[/h1]
I wanted to try getting maybe a bonus level and/or a free release of all the game assets done as part of this update also, but I just didn't end up having the time with the new baby and all.  But hopefully you enjoy the new weapons, and jumping back in to celebrate one year of wholesale goblin slaughter.  While Chop Goblins isn't the most successful, the deepest, or the best game I've made, it's one I'm extremely fond of, and I've enjoyed supporting it with new content and fixes.  Only time will tell what else the future holds for the goblins...

notes.title: Dusk developer blames his cat for releasing Chop Goblins three weeks early
notes.notes:
David Szymanski, the developer behind 2018 retro-styled shooter, Dusk, has just released his new game… three weeks ahead of schedule. Chop Goblins was anticipated to launch on 2 January 2023, but it appears David Szymanski and his cat had other ideas.

On 12 December, Chop Goblins hit Steam. Who did David Szymanski first blame for it? His cat, Zamboni. “WTF, I just came upstairs to my office and discovered the Zamboni released Chop Goblins early! They must remind him of himself,” the tweet reads.

Zamboni is pictured, sat on what we can assume to be David’s chair, looking innocent and adorable as ever. The Dusk creator later followed up with a new tweet, linking Chop Goblin’s Steam page, saying, “I was bored, so Chop Goblins is out now.” So, Zamboni isn’t an evil mastermind after all, but any excuse to share a cute cat picture (even if it means releasing a game early) is a good one if you ask me.

Read more

notes.title: Chop Goblins is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34055240/fb9d499a41ce38090225d570be2e54d4612d7a07.png[/img]

You thought it would be fun to break into a nearby museum and root through the artifacts stored there. Little did you know that a dusty chest in the basement imprisoned the evil [b]CHOP GOBLINS[/b].

Now they're loose, wrecking bladed havok on the world once again. It's up to you to chase them through the city and across space and time, in a bespoke FPS campaign spanning the modern day, 1800's Transylvania, ancient Greece, and the not too distant future.

[u]And you can finish it in about 30 minutes![/u]

[url=]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1935660/Chop_Goblins/[/url]

Chop Goblins is a "microshooter": An FPS designed to be completed in a single sitting, without sacrificing depth, variety, or creativity in its gameplay and level design. It's a game you can play for less than an hour, or replay for many hours. Need something to distract you from work, boredom, or grinding in other games? Take a Chop Goblins Break, with a fun and satisfying FPS campaign that only takes one sitting to fully experience.

notes.title: Time-travelling "bite-sized" FPS Chop Goblins is the next game from Dusk's dev

Szymanski says Chop Goblins’ campaign can be finished within a single sitting of around 30 minutes. Appropriately enough, it’s all about time travel.

notes.title: Dusk dev unveils Gremlins inspired retro FPS game Chop Goblins
notes.notes:
Dusk developer David Szymanski has unveiled his latest project - a one-sitting retro FPS game inspired by Gremlins called Chop Goblins, which sees you travelling across time after the eponymous antagonists and is positioned as an "all killer and no filler" experience. Following in the vein of classic games in the first-person shooter genre such as Doom, Quake, Half-Life, and Daikatana, Chop Goblins features a handful of unique weapons to wield across a number of globe-trotting locations, and it'll be arriving on Steam at the start of January 2023 to bring in the New Year in style.

Read the rest of the story...
